$comment: Golden NCR trips for phase-1 acceptance (spec §3 criterion 3). Trips were last re-probed on 2026-11-03 against the rebuilt 489-route feed with the BFF plausibility guard active (MAX_TRANSIT_SPEED_KMH = 120 km/h in services/api/src/routing/map-itinerary.ts); every count/mode/fare below is what the stack actually returned at the pinned departure. The 2026-11-03 re-probe followed the GTFS geometry fix (relation-member stitching and one shape per travel direction, see docs/runbooks/data-build.md): MOTIS no longer maps multi-kilometre shape chords onto a leg, so both the plausibility guard and the distance-based fares now see the real leg distances. Several corridors therefore gained cheaper, genuinely routable options (Novaliches->Cubao 104.46 -> 48.64 is two ordinary city-bus legs over the real 17.5 km; Cubao->Divisoria 51.92 -> 28.92) and the pinned fare bounds were refreshed from the live run instead of keeping prices inflated by the broken shapes. `minItineraries` is 3 for every trip per the criterion and is never lowered. `requiredModes` must appear in the union of the trip's itineraries, not in every itinerary. `fareBounds` are the live observed min/max rounded outward; they catch a broken fare engine without pinning exact prices.

trips.name: Cubao to Ayala
trips.note: MRT-3 corridor; live run returned 4 MRT-3 itineraries at PHP 10.50. Six provincial through-bus options (bus-cubaobalayan / bus-59 / bus-61) were dropped by the plausibility guard: their shapes claim 40-70 km in 2-4 minutes.

trips.name: Marikina to Cubao
trips.note: LRT-2 corridor; live run returned 5 itineraries (17.15 / 18.20 / 23.00), no implausible legs dropped.

trips.name: Cubao to Manila
trips.note: LRT-2 into Manila; live run returned 5 itineraries (22.62 / 24.00 / 48.91). The two ordinary city-bus options were previously dropped by the plausibility guard on their broken shapes; with the corrected feed they are real 8 km bus rides priced from the real distance, so the fare floor moved from 24 to 22.

trips.name: Pasay to Monumento
trips.note: LRT-1 corridor; live run returned 5 itineraries (35.90 / 48.37), no implausible legs dropped. The LRT-1 fare dropped from 47.16 because the corrected leg geometry no longer overstates the travelled distance.

trips.name: Cubao to Pasig
trips.note: Pasig River Ferry corridor; live run returned 5 itineraries (16.47 / 23.00) mixing the free PRFS ferry with bus and MRT-3; no implausible legs dropped.

trips.name: Pasay to Taguig
trips.note: Ferry + jeepney corridor; live run returned 5 itineraries (54.48 / 71.62 / 76.47); 12 impossible options dropped.

trips.name: Fairview to Manila
trips.note: Replaces the brief-era Fairview->Makati corridor, whose every option rode the defective uv-m01 shape (60,837 m in 2 min). Live run returned 5 bus itineraries (61.19 / 76.86); 15 impossible options dropped. The brief's jeepney+bus expectation never held on this data: before the guard the live set was bus + UV Express + MRT-3 + walk, i.e. only jeepney was absent.

trips.name: Novaliches to Cubao
trips.note: Replaces Novaliches->Ortigas, whose options all rode a 24,581 m jeepney leg in 2 minutes. Live run returned 4 bus itineraries at PHP 48.64: two ordinary city-bus legs (QC4 6.5 km + bus-51 11.0 km) priced from the real distances, where the old broken shapes had inflated the same corridor to PHP 104.46.

trips.name: Las Pinas to Makati
trips.note: South corridor; after the guard only the bus options are physically possible, so the required mode is bus (live run: 4 itineraries at PHP 67.96; 15 impossible LRT-1/UV/bus combinations dropped).

trips.name: Cubao to Divisoria
trips.note: Short heavy city bus corridor; live run returned 4 bus itineraries at PHP 28.92 (the old 51.92 was priced from the inflated shape distance), no implausible legs dropped.
